resolved_comments.text: HRFAISSProvider.load_index is decorated by lru_cache outside the publication lock. The body releases the lock before functools inserts its result. A concurrent save can publish new index and clear both caches, after which the suspended reader inserts the OLD facade back into the HR cache. New reads then serve stale content despite completed save. Deterministic scheduling test reproduces old != new. Acquire publication lock outside cached lookup/insertion while retaining load_index.cache_clear compatibility; rerun regression.
resolved_comments.resolution: Fixed by outer load_index publication lock wrapping the inner cached helper; public load_index.cache_clear delegates to helper. Independent deterministic reader/save race now passes.
